candidate_merges.message: Preserve child exception stacks in dashboard aggregate-error telemetry (#20732) ## Description Dashboard telemetry for Blazor circuit error 111 can contain an `AggregateException` with an empty stack trace. Blazor creates disposal aggregates and passes them directly to its error handler without throwing them, so the original stacks are on the child exceptions rather than the aggregate. Record the child exception types, messages, and stacks instead, so disposal failures can be traced to the affec

candidate_merges.message: Prepare repository metadata for Aspire 17.0 (#20569) ## Description Remove the disabled, temporary main-to-release/14.0 synchronization workflow, its harness/tests, watchdog entry, and obsolete operating instructions. That workflow served the advance integration branch while `main` developed 13.6 and is no longer needed. Restrict the `main` milestone rule to merged PRs so PRs closed without merging are not assigned milestone 17.0. Leave the existing `release/13.6` rule unchanged. Per review feed

candidate_merges.message: Add Mermaid resource graph export to the dashboard and CLI (#20746) ## Description Resource graphs are useful for documenting and sharing an application's topology, but currently cannot be exported from the dashboard or CLI. This adds **Export as Mermaid** to the graph controls, opening a large dialog with the generated source, **Copy to clipboard**, and **Download** as `resources.mmd`. It also adds `aspire resources --format mermaid` (and `aspire describe --format mermaid`) for direct file redi
